data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish name 'Padraig', meaning 'noble' or 'generous'. In Irish mythology, Padraig is a name associated with the patron saint of Ireland. The name Padraic carries the meaning “Noble, Generous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Padraic usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Padraic total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Padraic is deeply rooted in Irish culture and history. Padraig, also known as St. Patrick, is the patron saint of Ireland and is celebrated each year on March 17th, St. Patrick's Day. This day is not only celebrated in Ireland but around the world, reflecting the global reach of Irish culture. The name Padraic holds a rich and significant cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: Padraic, as a Christian name, is rooted in the belief of being noble and generous, qualities that align well with the teachings of Christianity. As a tribute to St. Patrick, the name carries a spiritual meaning symbolizing the generosity and nobility of the Christian faith. It is a reminder of the selflessness and kindness that is encouraged in the Bible and lived out by the life of St. Patrick.
